3. // The MicroVM platform's guest-virtual -> guest-physical translation map.
4. //
5. // MicroVM runs the guest identity-mapped, so the abstract map is the identity
6. // over the entire usize address space. This is a platform-level invariant (the
7. // VMM maps GVA == GPA), NOT an implementation artifact: any reimplementation of
8. // the translation on MicroVM must still yield the identity, so the equality is
9. // part of the contract, hence `open`.
10. //
11. // Total: defined for every address. Deterministic: a function of `gva` alone.
12. // Frame correspondence (the caller's load-bearing property) and injectivity are
13. // immediate corollaries of this identity.
14. pub open spec fn spec_gva_to_gpa(gva: int) -> int {
15.     gva
16. }
17. 
18. } // verus!
19.

88. /// Number of page tables needed for identity-mapping physical memory regions.
89. ///
90. /// On microvm all physical memory is contiguous starting at GPA 0, so the base count
91. /// (one page table per `PGTAB_SIZE` bytes) is sufficient. When the WHP backend is enabled,
92. /// an additional page table is needed for the LAPIC MMIO region at `0xFEE0_0000`, which
93. /// lies outside the identity-mapped physical memory range.
94. ///
95. #[cfg(feature = "whp")]
96. pub const NUM_PAGE_TABLES: usize = config::kernel::MEMORY_SIZE / mem::PGTAB_SIZE + 1;
97. #[cfg(not(feature = "whp"))]
98. pub const NUM_PAGE_TABLES: usize = config::kernel::MEMORY_SIZE / mem::PGTAB_SIZE;
99.
